name: rask-example-server-islands
description: Island dependencies for the Server showcase. Rask itself needs no npm; a React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Angular or Lit component does, and needing one is inherent to asking for it. Preact is the seventh runtime and cannot appear here: @preact/preset-vite pins @babel/core 7 where @vitejs/plugin-react resolves Babel 8, so npm refuses to install both — Preact swaps in for React rather than sitting beside it. Angular needs three packages its Vite plugin imports but does not depend on (@angular/compiler-cli, @angular/build, and the compiler), and pins typescript below 6.1.
